lines.text: Whatever have you been doing with yourself, Watson?
lines.speaker: Character_C

lines.text: You are as thin as a lath and as brown as a nut.
lines.speaker: Character_C

lines.text: Poor devil!
lines.speaker: Character_C

lines.text: What are you up to now?
lines.speaker: Character_C

lines.text: Looking for lodgings,
lines.speaker: Character_B

lines.text: Trying to solve the problem as to whether it is possible to get comfortable rooms at a reasonable price.
lines.speaker: Character_B

lines.text: That’s a strange thing,
lines.speaker: Character_C

lines.text: you are the second man to-day that has used that expression to me.
lines.speaker: Character_C

lines.text: And who was the first?
lines.speaker: Character_B

lines.text: A fellow who is working at the chemical laboratory up at the hospital.
lines.speaker: Character_C

lines.text: He was bemoaning himself this morning because he could not get someone to go halves with him in some nice rooms which he had found, and which were too much for his purse.
lines.speaker: Character_C

lines.text: By Jove!
lines.speaker: Character_B

lines.text: if he really wants someone to share the rooms and the expense, I am the very man for him.
lines.speaker: Character_B

lines.text: I should prefer having a partner to being alone.
lines.speaker: Character_B

lines.text: You don’t know Sherlock Holmes yet,
lines.speaker: Character_C

lines.text: perhaps you would not care for him as a constant companion.
lines.speaker: Character_C

lines.text: Why, what is there against him?
lines.speaker: Character_B

lines.text: Oh, I didn’t say there was anything against him.
lines.speaker: Character_C

lines.text: He is a little queer in his ideas—an enthusiast in some branches of science.
lines.speaker: Character_C

lines.text: As far as I know he is a decent fellow enough.
lines.speaker: Character_C

lines.text: A medical student, I suppose?
lines.speaker: Character_B

lines.text: No—I have no idea what he intends to go in for.
lines.speaker: Character_C

lines.text: I believe he is well up in anatomy, and he is a first-class chemist; but, as far as I know, he has never taken out any systematic medical classes.
lines.speaker: Character_C

lines.text: His studies are very desultory and eccentric, but he has amassed a lot of out-of-the-way knowledge which would astonish his professors.
lines.speaker: Character_C

lines.text: Did you never ask him what he was going in for?
lines.speaker: Character_B

lines.text: No; he is not a man that it is easy to draw out, though he can be communicative enough when the fancy seizes him.
lines.speaker: Character_C

lines.text: I should like to meet him,
lines.speaker: Character_B

lines.text: If I am to lodge with anyone, I should prefer a man of studious and quiet habits.
lines.speaker: Character_B

lines.text: I am not strong enough yet to stand much noise or excitement.
lines.speaker: Character_B

lines.text: I had enough of both in Afghanistan to last me for the remainder of my natural existence.
lines.speaker: Character_B

lines.text: How could I meet this friend of yours?
lines.speaker: Character_B

lines.text: He is sure to be at the laboratory,
lines.speaker: Character_C

lines.text: He either avoids the place for weeks, or else he works there from morning to night.
lines.speaker: Character_C

lines.text: If you like, we shall drive round together after luncheon.
lines.speaker: Character_C

lines.text: Certainly,
lines.speaker: Character_B

lines.text: You mustn’t blame me if you don’t get on with him,
lines.speaker: Character_C

lines.text: I know nothing more of him than I have learned from meeting him occasionally in the laboratory.
lines.speaker: Character_C

lines.text: You proposed this arrangement, so you must not hold me responsible.
lines.speaker: Character_C

lines.text: If we don’t get on it will be easy to part company,
lines.speaker: Character_B

lines.text: It seems to me, Stamford,
lines.speaker: Character_B

lines.text: that you have some reason for washing your hands of the matter.
lines.speaker: Character_B

lines.text: Is this fellow’s temper so formidable, or what is it?
lines.speaker: Character_B

lines.text: Don’t be mealy-mouthed about it.
lines.speaker: Character_B

lines.text: It is not easy to express the inexpressible,
lines.speaker: Character_C

lines.text: Holmes is a little too scientific for my tastes—it approaches to cold-bloodedness.
lines.speaker: Character_C

lines.text: I could imagine his giving a friend a little pinch of the latest vegetable alkaloid, not out of malevolence, you understand, but simply out of a spirit of inquiry in order to have an accurate idea of the effects.
lines.speaker: Character_C

lines.text: To do him justice, I think that he would take it himself with the same readiness.
lines.speaker: Character_C

lines.text: He appears to have a passion for definite and exact knowledge.
lines.speaker: Character_C

lines.text: Very right too.
lines.speaker: Character_B

lines.text: Yes, but it may be pushed to excess.
lines.speaker: Character_C

lines.text: When it comes to beating the subjects in the dissecting-rooms with a stick, it is certainly taking rather a bizarre shape.
lines.speaker: Character_C

lines.text: Beating the subjects!
lines.speaker: Character_B

lines.text: Yes, to verify how far bruises may be produced after death.
lines.speaker: Character_C

lines.text: I saw him at it with my own eyes.
lines.speaker: Character_C

lines.text: And yet you say he is not a medical student?
lines.speaker: Character_B

lines.text: No.
lines.speaker: Character_C

lines.text: Heaven knows what the objects of his studies are.
lines.speaker: Character_C

lines.text: But here we are, and you must form your own impressions about him.
lines.speaker: Character_C

lines.text: I’ve found it!
lines.speaker: Character_A

lines.text: I’ve found it,
lines.speaker: Character_A

lines.text: I have found a re-agent which is precipitated by hæmoglobin, and by nothing else.
lines.speaker: Character_A

lines.text: Dr.
lines.speaker: Character_C

lines.text: Watson, Mr.
lines.speaker: Character_C

lines.text: Sherlock Holmes,
lines.speaker: Character_C

lines.text: How are you?
lines.speaker: Character_A

lines.text: You have been in Afghanistan, I perceive.
lines.speaker: Character_A

lines.text: How on earth did you know that?
lines.speaker: Character_B

lines.text: Never mind,
lines.speaker: Character_A

lines.text: The question now is about hæmoglobin.
lines.speaker: Character_A

lines.text: No doubt you see the significance of this discovery of mine?
lines.speaker: Character_A

lines.text: It is interesting, chemically, no doubt,
lines.speaker: Character_B

lines.text: but practically——
lines.speaker: Character_B

lines.text: Why, man, it is the most practical medico-legal discovery for years.
lines.speaker: Character_A

lines.text: Don’t you see that it gives us an infallible test for blood stains.
lines.speaker: Character_A

lines.text: Come over here now!
lines.speaker: Character_A

lines.text: Let us have some fresh blood,
lines.speaker: Character_A

lines.text: Now, I add this small quantity of blood to a litre of water.
lines.speaker: Character_A

lines.text: You perceive that the resulting mixture has the appearance of pure water.
lines.speaker: Character_A

lines.text: The proportion of blood cannot be more than one in a million.
lines.speaker: Character_A

lines.text: I have no doubt, however, that we shall be able to obtain the characteristic reaction.
lines.speaker: Character_A

lines.text: Ha!
lines.speaker: Character_A

lines.text: ha!
lines.speaker: Character_A

lines.text: What do you think of that?
lines.speaker: Character_A

lines.text: It seems to be a very delicate test,
lines.speaker: Character_B

lines.text: Beautiful!
lines.speaker: Character_A

lines.text: beautiful!
lines.speaker: Character_A

lines.text: The old Guiacum test was very clumsy and uncertain.
lines.speaker: Character_A

lines.text: So is the microscopic examination for blood corpuscles.
lines.speaker: Character_A

lines.text: The latter is valueless if the stains are a few hours old.
lines.speaker: Character_A

lines.text: Now, this appears to act as well whether the blood is old or new.
lines.speaker: Character_A

lines.text: Had this test been invented, there are hundreds of men now walking the earth who would long ago have paid the penalty of their crimes.
lines.speaker: Character_A

lines.text: Indeed!
lines.speaker: Character_B

lines.text: Criminal cases are continually hinging upon that one point.
lines.speaker: Character_A

lines.text: A man is suspected of a crime months perhaps after it has been committed.
lines.speaker: Character_A

lines.text: His linen or clothes are examined, and brownish stains discovered upon them.
lines.speaker: Character_A

lines.text: Are they blood stains, or mud stains, or rust stains, or fruit stains, or what are they?
lines.speaker: Character_A

lines.text: That is a question which has puzzled many an expert, and why?
lines.speaker: Character_A

lines.text: Because there was no reliable test.
lines.speaker: Character_A

lines.text: Now we have the Sherlock Holmes’ test, and there will no longer be any difficulty.
lines.speaker: Character_A

lines.text: You are to be congratulated,
lines.speaker: Character_B

lines.text: There was the case of Von Bischoff at Frankfort last year.
lines.speaker: Character_A

lines.text: He would certainly have been hung had this test been in existence.
lines.speaker: Character_A

lines.text: Then there was Mason of Bradford, and the notorious Muller, and Lefevre of Montpellier, and Samson of New Orleans.
lines.speaker: Character_A

lines.text: I could name a score of cases in which it would have been decisive.
lines.speaker: Character_A

lines.text: You seem to be a walking calendar of crime,
lines.speaker: Character_C

lines.text: You might start a paper on those lines.
lines.speaker: Character_C

lines.text: Call it the ‘Police News of the Past.’
lines.speaker: Character_C

lines.text: Very interesting reading it might be made, too,
lines.speaker: Character_A

lines.text: I have to be careful,
lines.speaker: Character_A

lines.text: for I dabble with poisons a good deal.
lines.speaker: Character_A

lines.text: We came here on business,
lines.speaker: Character_C

lines.text: My friend here wants to take diggings, and as you were complaining that you could get no one to go halves with you, I thought that I had better bring you together.
lines.speaker: Character_C

lines.text: I have my eye on a suite in Baker Street,
lines.speaker: Character_A

lines.text: which would suit us down to the ground.
lines.speaker: Character_A

lines.text: You don’t mind the smell of strong tobacco, I hope?
lines.speaker: Character_A

lines.text: I always smoke ‘ship’s’ myself,
lines.speaker: Character_B

lines.text: That’s good enough.
lines.speaker: Character_A

lines.text: I generally have chemicals about, and occasionally do experiments.
lines.speaker: Character_A

lines.text: Would that annoy you?
lines.speaker: Character_A

lines.text: By no means.
lines.speaker: Character_B

lines.text: Let me see—what are my other shortcomings.
lines.speaker: Character_A

lines.text: I get in the dumps at times, and don’t open my mouth for days on end.
lines.speaker: Character_A

lines.text: You must not think I am sulky when I do that.
lines.speaker: Character_A

lines.text: Just let me alone, and I’ll soon be right.
lines.speaker: Character_A

lines.text: What have you to confess now?
lines.speaker: Character_A

lines.text: It’s just as well for two fellows to know the worst of one another before they begin to live together.
lines.speaker: Character_A

lines.text: I keep a bull pup,
lines.speaker: Character_B

lines.text: and I object to rows because my nerves are shaken, and I get up at all sorts of ungodly hours, and I am extremely lazy.
lines.speaker: Character_B

lines.text: I have another set of vices when I’m well, but those are the principal ones at present.
lines.speaker: Character_B

lines.text: Do you include violin-playing in your category of rows?
lines.speaker: Character_A

lines.text: It depends on the player,
lines.speaker: Character_B

lines.text: A well-played violin is a treat for the gods—a badly-played one——
lines.speaker: Character_B

lines.text: Oh, that’s all right,
lines.speaker: Character_A

lines.text: I think we may consider the thing as settled—that is, if the rooms are agreeable to you.
lines.speaker: Character_A

lines.text: When shall we see them?
lines.speaker: Character_B

lines.text: Call for me here at noon to-morrow, and we’ll go together and settle everything,
lines.speaker: Character_A

lines.text: All right—noon exactly,
lines.speaker: Character_B

lines.text: By the way,
lines.speaker: Character_B

lines.text: how the deuce did he know that I had come from Afghanistan?
lines.speaker: Character_B

lines.text: That’s just his little peculiarity,
lines.speaker: Character_C

lines.text: A good many people have wanted to know how he finds things out.
lines.speaker: Character_C

lines.text: Oh!
lines.speaker: Character_B

lines.text: a mystery is it?
lines.speaker: Character_B

lines.text: This is very piquant.
lines.speaker: Character_B

lines.text: I am much obliged to you for bringing us together.
lines.speaker: Character_B

lines.text: ‘The proper study of mankind is man,’ you know.
lines.speaker: Character_B

lines.text: You must study him, then,
lines.speaker: Character_C

lines.text: You’ll find him a knotty problem, though.
lines.speaker: Character_C

lines.text: I’ll wager he learns more about you than you about him.
lines.speaker: Character_C

lines.text: Good-bye.
lines.speaker: Character_C

lines.text: Good-bye,
lines.speaker: Character_B
